title: Hearing on waste valorization and the circular economy
summary: The Council's Sanitation Committee held an oversight hearing on reducing NYC's waste stream through recycling, composting and reuse, examining options such as textile recycling mandates, anaerobic digestion, waste-to-energy incineration and construction debris reuse. Only 21.8% of DSNY-managed waste was recycled or reused in fiscal year 2025, and the City exports about 10,670 tons of waste daily. The hearing also covered related bills on textile recycling study, nightlife district street cleaning, community composting on parkland and a state bottle deposit bill.
